description: This interface defines data access methods for module configurations within the sales manager system, specifying methods to retrieve module configurations and find modules by code.

classes.name: ModuleConfigurationDao
classes.description: Java interface extending SalesManagerEntityDao to access IntegrationModule entities and provide custom query methods.

methods.name: getModulesConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves a list of IntegrationModule configurations filtered by the specified module name.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a single IntegrationModule instance identified uniquely by its code.
